terminal.title: WCam {version}
terminal.scan_hint: The first time, the browser warns about the certificate: check that the fingerprint matches and continue.
terminal.no_lan: No local network found. Connect this computer to Wi-Fi and try again.
terminal.scan_with_token: Scan this QR code with your phone camera. It works once, for 2 minutes. To get a new one, open the console.
terminal.virtual_camera_fallback: The WCam camera is not available on this computer, so the OBS Virtual Camera is used instead.
terminal.scan_in_console: Open the console on this computer to see the QR code: {url}
console.confirm_title: Is the code on the phone the same as this one?
console.virtual_camera_driver_missing: Install OBS Studio to get the virtual camera.
console.virtual_camera_device_in_use: Turn off the OBS virtual camera and restart WCam.
console.virtual_camera_error: The virtual camera failed to start.
console.source_frozen: Showing the last image until the phone's video comes back
console.camera_color: Phone camera color: {primaries} primaries, {transfer} transfer, {matrix} matrix, {range} range
console.camera_color_unknown: Phone camera color: not reported by the browser
console.dev_compare_camera_denied: The browser did not allow this page to use the WCam camera. Allow the camera and try again.
console.dev_compare_camera_missing: The WCam camera does not show up on this computer.
console.dev_compare_camera_busy: Could not open the WCam camera. Close other apps using the camera and try again.
console.dev_compare_camera_failed: Could not open the WCam camera in this browser.
console.dev_compare_phone_timeout: The phone did not send its image in time.
console.dev_compare_phone_invalid: The phone image arrived incomplete. Try again.
console.dev_compare_pc_missing: The WCam camera image did not arrive in time.
console.dev_compare_session_ended: The connection to the phone ended before the capture.
console.dev_compare_not_live: The phone needs to be showing its image to compare.
console.dev_compare_screen_hint: Original PNG screenshot from the phone, sent as a file

format.name: {resolution}, {frameRate}
console.format_pending: The new image format starts when the app using the WCam camera closes and opens it again.
cam.portrait_hint: Turn the phone sideways to fill the computer screen.
cam.missing_pairing: Scan the QR code WCam shows on your computer.
cam.intro_title: Use this phone as your webcam
cam.intro_body: WCam needs the camera. Video only goes to your computer on this network and is never recorded.
cam.requesting: Allow camera access in the browser prompt
cam.denied_body: Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
cam.unavailable_unsupported: Use Chrome or Safari to open the camera.
cam.unavailable_no_camera: No camera found on this device.
cam.unavailable_in_use: Close the other app using the camera.
cam.preview_hidden: Preview off. The camera is still on. Tap anywhere to show it.
cam.keep_screen_on: Keep the screen on in your phone settings while using WCam.
cam.confirm_title: Is the code on the computer the same as this one?
cam.pairing_failed: This QR code is no longer valid. Scan a new one.
cam.blocked_network: This phone is not on the computer's network.
cam.ended_rejected: The computer did not accept this phone.
cam.ended_lost: Connection lost. Scan a new QR code.
cam.ended_timeout: Not confirmed in time. Scan a new QR code.
cam.dev_screenshot_failed: Screenshot not sent. Use the original PNG.
errors.network_error: WCam on the computer is not responding. Check that it is open.
errors.not_same_network: This device is not on the same network as the computer.
errors.invalid_host: This address is not allowed. Open WCam from the link it shows.
errors.web_not_built: This page has not been built yet.
errors.method_not_allowed: This action is not supported here.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong in WCam on the computer.
errors.pairing_token_invalid: This QR code is no longer valid.
errors.pairing_window_closed: There is no open QR code on the computer. Get a new one in the console.
errors.no_session_awaiting_confirmation: No phone is waiting for confirmation.
terminal.confirm_hint: Check the code in the console on this computer and on the phone.
console.step_same_wifi: Phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi
console.step_certificate: The first time, the phone warns about the site's security. Tap to continue.
console.step_code: Check the code on both devices
console.preview_hidden: Preview off. Apps keep receiving the image.
console.apps_none: No app is using the camera
cam.ended_code_different: The code was not the same. Someone else may have scanned the QR code. Get a new one on the computer.
errors.no_live_session: The phone needs to be showing the image for that.
